rounds.text: Arigato Universe Ltd is significantly under-appreciated by the market, trading at a modest P/E of 13.6x [E1] that sits at a steep discount to the sector benchmark of 66.66x [E6]. This valuation disconnect is rendered even more striking by explosive fundamental momentum, evidenced by a staggering 3-year compounded sales growth of 347% [E16] and an annualized profit growth of 169% over the trailing twelve months [E21]. Profitability metrics are exceptional, delivering a 27.0% ROE [E13] and 20.4% ROCE [E12], comfortably outperforming the broader sector benchmarks [E9, E10]. Furthermore, the company has successfully achieved a debt-free status with borrowings dropping to zero [E39], while working capital efficiency has transformed dramatically as debtor days plummeted from 263 to 61.3 days [E59]. Insider confidence is exceptionally high, demonstrated by promoters aggressively raising their stake to 65.24% by June 2026 from just 0.77% in September 2023 [E41]. Underlying this transformation, a quantitative rules-based screen awards the company a high-confidence BUY score of 87 out of 100 [E63], and a discounted cash flow model suggests a massive intrinsic valuation gap with a 66.5% margin of safety [E43, E44]. Conceded: operating cash flow is negative at Rs -6.44 Cr for Mar 2026 resulting in a weak cash conversion ratio of -2.84x [E34, E35].
